meta.scope: Recover S044 reported EEG pain construct, 91-person overlap-aware sample design and bounded external-validation results

records.title: External validation of EEG-based machine learning models for continuous pain prediction

decisions.notes: NLM abstract identifies 91 distinct participants and three analysis samples (40 development, 51 cross-subject external, 25 repeat sessions from sample 1). Regression did not beat the mean-rating dummy despite beating random prediction. External refers to author-reported held-out samples in experimental pressure pain, not independent clinical-site validation, ECAP or SCS. Earlier Liverpool VOR version relation remains author-declared, not registered in Crossref.

updates.задача: Continuous experimental pain-rating prediction and low/high trial classification
updates.метод: Random Forest and LSTM regression on single-trial EEG time-frequency features; RF low/high classifier
updates.датасет: 91 distinct participants: sample 1 n=40 for model development, sample 2 n=51 for cross-subject external validation; sample 3 n=25 consists of additional sessions from sample-1 participants, not 25 additional people.
updates.производительность: Experimental pneumatic-pressure pain ratings: RF continuous-prediction MAE 19.59 internal, 21.29 cross-subject external and 18.90 within-subject temporal external; neither regression model beat a mean-training-rating dummy. Low/high classifier accuracies up to 64% internal and 58% external. These are author-reported study samples, not clinical chronic-pain validation.
updates.кросс_субъект: Yes: held-out sample 2 (n=51) is a cross-subject external sample; sample 3 (n=25) is repeat sessions from sample-1 participants for within-subject temporal validation.
